scope: For a finite measure and measurable nonnegative real observable c, the measure of {x | c x < 1 / max t 1} tends to the measure of {x | c x = 0} as t tends to infinity. In the conditional packet application, this formalizes the shrinking exceptional-band measure step only after the direction-law, observable measurability, and zero-mass assumptions are supplied.
